title: Eric TikTok — the 100-year-old Danish pharma company whose nonprofit board protected GLP-1s and insulin
summary: Eric posts a launch-week TikTok telling the Novo Nordisk story from the book: a 100-year-old Danish pharma company founded by one of Denmark's first female doctors and her Nobel Laureate husband, whose nonprofit foundation board structure made GLP-1 drugs and insulin possible.
blockquote: This story will bend your mind about the invention of GLP-1 drugs and insulin by a 100 year old pharma company and protected by their non-profit board. Founded by one of Denmark's first female doctors and her Nobel Laureate husband.
